1. Welcome to the Team
Congratulations on joining Apex Global Technologies! Our onboarding framework is structured around the 30-60-90
Day Success Pathway, designed to provide the tools, context, and support necessary to transition smoothly into
your role and deliver meaningful impact.
2. Pre-Boarding Phase (T-minus 14 to Day 0)
Before your first day, People Operations and IT Desktop Engineering coordinate several critical milestones:
Background Screening & Documentation: Completion of background checks, digital offer acceptance, and
direct deposit details via the pre-boarding portal.
Hardware Selection: Choice of standard engineering workstation (Apple MacBook Pro 16" M3 Max 36GB RAM
or Lenovo ThinkPad P1 Gen 6 Linux/Windows) submitted 10 days prior to start.
Welcome Package & Onboarding Buddy Assignment: Receipt of the Apex welcome box, corporate swag, and
an introductory email from your assigned Onboarding Buddy.
3. Day 1: Arrival, Orientation, and Hardware Provisioning

4. First-Week Day-by-Day Milestone Checklist
First Week In-Office Attendance Requirement
Reminder: As detailed in the Remote Work Policy, all new hires must be on-site at the corporate office for their entire
first week (Monday through Friday) to complete hands-on provisioning, pairing, and compliance verification. 
Day
Core Focus Area
Required Completion Checklist
Day 1 (Mon)
Identity, Hardware & Accounts
I-9 verified; Okta SSO active; YubiKey enrolled; Laptop configured;
Slack introduction posted.
Day 2 (Tue)
Compliance & Development Setup
Complete mandatory Security Awareness & Phishing module; install
Homebrew, Python 3.11, Docker, and IDE; generate SSH/GPG
keys.
Day 3 (Wed)
Architecture Deep Dive & Repo
Clone
Clone primary service repos; execute local build and test suites;
attend first team morning standup; review system architecture docs.
Day 4 (Thu)
First Commit & Buddy Pairing
Pair programming with Onboarding Buddy; pick up first "good-first-
issue" starter ticket; open draft Pull Request adhering to Git
standards.
Day 5 (Fri)
Sprint Retrospective & 30-Day
OKRs
PR reviewed and merged to staging; 1:1 check-in with Manager to
finalize 30-60-90 day goals; team Friday afternoon wind-down.
5. 30-60-90 Day Milestone Expectations
First 30 Days (Assimilation): Master team workflows, understand deployment pipelines, resolve 3-5 minor bug
tickets or feature tasks, complete all compliance training modules.
First 60 Days (Independence): Own feature tasks from design to staging deployment, participate in code reviews
for peers, shadow an engineer during an on-call rotation.
First 90 Days (Full Velocity): Independent contribution to critical architectural sprints, participate in production
releases, enter the regular team on-call rotation, formal 90-day review.
